user_input: Write me a poem about invoking spirits to bring pleasant dreams:
model_output:
Invoke the spirits of night,
To bring us dreams of light,
To guide us through the darkness,
And fill our hearts with delight.

Close your eyes and focus deep,
On the calming sound of your breath,
Let your mind relax and slip,
Into the realm of sweet reprieve.

Imagine the spirits near,
Bringing peace and harmony,
To soothe your mind and body,
And help you fly on high.

Ask for gentle dreams to come,
That bring joy and love,
And banish away any fears,
That have been causing strife.

Trust in the spirits' power,
To guide you through the night,
And when you awaken,
You'll feel refreshed and bright.
